intermittent_fasting.benefits: Improves insulin sensitivity, promotes cellular repair (autophagy), aids weight management.

juice_fasting.method: Consuming only freshly pressed, unpasteurized fruit and vegetable juices, clear broths, and herbal teas. No solid food.

water_fasting.method: Strict intake of only pure water. Requires mental and physical rest.
water_fasting.preparation: 3 days of raw foods/juices prior to starting.
water_fasting.breaking_the_fast: Break with diluted fruit juice, followed by whole fruits the next day. Slow transition is critical.
water_fasting.benefits: Maximum autophagy, immune system reset, profound healing of inflammatory conditions.

mono_diet.method: Eating only one type of easily digestible food for a specific period.
mono_diet.benefits: Reduces digestive burden while still providing energy; excellent for sensitive guts.

elimination_diet.method: Removing common allergens/irritants for 21 days, then reintroducing them one by one to identify triggers.
elimination_diet.benefits: Identifies food intolerances, reduces systemic inflammation, heals leaky gut.

raw_food_diet.principles: Consuming predominantly (70-100%) uncooked, unprocessed plant foods. Foods are not heated above 48°C (118°F) to preserve enzymes.
raw_food_diet.benefits: High enzyme intake, highly alkalizing, excellent for reversing metabolic syndrome.

sattvic_diet.principles: Yogic diet emphasizing purity, peace, and lightness. Foods are fresh, lightly cooked, and easily digestible.
sattvic_diet.benefits: Calms the mind, supports meditation, gentle on the digestive system.

alkaline_diet.principles: Focuses on foods that leave an alkaline ash in the body to balance blood pH and reduce acid load.
alkaline_diet.benefits: Reduces inflammation, preserves bone mass, improves energy.

meal_timing_principles.breakfast: Eat like a king. Largest meal of the day if physical work is high, or keep it light with fruits if doing sedentary work. Best time: 7:00 AM - 9:00 AM.
meal_timing_principles.lunch: Main meal of the day when digestive fire (Agni) is highest. Best time: 12:00 PM - 2:00 PM.
meal_timing_principles.dinner: Lightest meal. Should be consumed before sunset or at least 3 hours before sleep. Avoid heavy proteins and raw cold salads at night. Best time: 6:00 PM - 7:30 PM.
meal_timing_principles.general_rules: Eat only when truly hungry. Fill 50% of stomach with food, 25% with water, leave 25% empty for air and digestion. Drink water 1 hour before or 1 hour after meals, never during meals.
